subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage reflects on a time in the past, specifically referring to an event that no longer occurs, which requires the past tense "were."
 
• "Were" correctly matches the subject "there," indicating that in the past, there were never many girls at the football games.
 
• Other options ("are," "was," "where") do not fit the context of describing a past situation where the number of girls was not many.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Are"** is present tense and does not fit the past context.
 
• **"Was" **is singular and does not match the plural subject "there." 
 
• **"Where"** is a location, which does not make sense in this context.
